description: Deletes one of the signed-in user's own comments, by its commentId and the postId it belongs to; it disappears at once and cannot be restored, so confirm with the user first. Only its author may delete it here, an admin account included.

commentId.description: UUID of the comment, as get_comments and create_comment return it.

postId.description: UUID of the post or event the comment is on.

name: delete_comment
title: Delete comment
